podcast.title: U2 Tour Designer Since 1983
podcast.body: Willie Williams has been the exclusive designer for all of U2's tours since 1983, including iconic productions like The Joshua Tree stage, Zoo TV, PopMart, and 360, demonstrating a long-standing and crucial creative role for the band. "Willie has designed all of you two's tours since 1983, the Joshua Tree stage, Zoo TV, Popmart 360, all of them."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: We Are The Road Crew - A History of Roadies

podcast.title: Early Career in London Punk Scene
podcast.body: Willie Williams started his career in the music industry by doing lights for punk gigs in London, catching the "road bug" early in his life. "He got bit by the road bug early when he started doing lights for punk gigs in London."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: We Are The Road Crew - A History of Roadies

podcast.title: Extensive Work as Designer
podcast.body: Over the years, Willie Williams has worked with numerous famous artists, including R.E.M., David Bowie, The Rolling Stones, George Michael, and notably, U2, designing their tours. "And over the years, he's worked with R.E.M. David Bowie, the Rolling Stones, George Michael, and of course you two."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
